sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Rewrite the bounded envelope constraint so coverage failures are violations: the current FILTER(?coveredWaterlines = ?requiredWaterlines) suppresses evaluation and accidentally passes whenever an intended-waterline or LIWL segment is missing at a critical longitudinal position. Preserve breakpoint, segment-interior, crossing, and shared-domain coverage using the existing owner paths and SHACL Core presence/datatype/metre checks, without OPTIONAL inside FILTER NOT EXISTS. Remove the invented 1e-6 relative/fallback constants and use only an approved tolerance scaled from the expected envelope value, not the reported LIWL value; do not use exact equality. No vocabulary matching is needed.
